objective: Preregister the single sent_accel feature-IC candidate (SENT01) for dir:llm_8k_gdelt_sentiment_acceleration's cheapest falsification pilot, before any DeepSeek score or IC number is computed. Universe capped to a fixed-seed random 50-ticker sample of the 2026-Q2 8-K universe (see candidate SENT01 parameters.universe_sampling) to keep the DeepSeek call volume small.

parameters.rationale: Reproduces LLM_Alpha's sent_accel construction exactly (window lengths, horizon, rank-weighting grammar); source: github.com/quangkhaidataka/LLM_Alpha, see direction-review.json.
parameters.universe_sampling: Fixed-seed random.Random(20260928).sample(...) of 50 tickers from the 1343 tickers with an 'ok' fetch_status 8-K text in data/features/earnings_events/2026.parquet for 2026 Q2 (2026-04-01..2026-06-30), chosen before any DeepSeek call to keep the pilot within a small, tractable DeepSeek call budget (the full-universe alternative would be ~1400 8-K items + ~31700 matched news items -- far outside a 'cheapest falsification test' budget).

data_v1_h20260928_16_8k_news_sip.universe: tickers with >=1 8-K filing in 2026 Q2 (2026-04-01..2026-06-30) in data/features/earnings_events/2026.parquet
data_v1_h20260928_16_8k_news_sip.confirmed_coverage: 2026.parquet has 1506 8-K rows in 2026 Q2 (2026Q1=1577, Q2=1506, Q3=1469 partial as of 2026-09-17); news_packets/2026.parquet has 174394 rows with visible_at through 2026-09-17; both confirmed present via pandas on 2026-09-28.

feature_v1_h20260928_16_sent_accel.definition: Per (ticker, day t): raw_pol_k = polarity_k*magnitude_k for each 8-K/news item k with visible_at <= t (PIT join -- an item whose visible_at is after t is excluded from the feature at t, see tests/test_h20260928_16_sentiment_accel.py). short_ma_t = 5-trading-day rolling mean of raw_pol; long_ma_t = 20-trading-day rolling mean of raw_pol; accel_t = short_ma_t - long_ma_t; sent_accel_t = -1*(cs_rank(accel_t) - 0.5) (LLM_Alpha's negated convention); accel_t itself (un-negated) is also reported, since independent verification found the negation's cited justification (EMP2018) does not state a sentiment-acceleration reversal rule -- see direction-review.json remaining_evidence_gap.

label_v1_h20260928_16_forward_5d_return.definition: close-to-close forward 5-trading-day return from day t+1 open to day t+6 open (close signal at t, next_bar_open fill, matching the frozen project convention); IC is Spearman rank correlation between the day-t cross-sectional feature and each ticker's forward 5-day return.

validation_v1_h20260928_16_ic_and_placeb.placebo: shuffle news/8-K item ticker assignment across tickers within the same calendar date, recompute the identical feature pipeline, recompute IC

cost_v1_h20260928_16_no_cost_ic_only.definition: No cost model -- this pilot computes a feature and its IC only, no positions, no trades, no backtest.

benchmark_v1_h20260928_16_placebo_compar.definition: Real feature's daily rank IC vs the shuffled-news placebo's daily rank IC, both vs forward 5-day returns; also reports both the negated (sent_accel) and un-negated (accel) sign conventions.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: Single candidate; no multiple-comparisons correction applicable (n_trials=1). This pilot does not compute or report a Sharpe/DSR -- it is an IC-only feature check.

keep_rule.pass_condition: Mean daily rank IC over 2026 Q2 has a stable sign (>=60% of days share the mean's sign) AND the placebo's mean |IC| is <50% of the real mean |IC| (same sign).
keep_rule.fail_condition: Either condition fails -> stop before any CV harness or backtest (direction-review.json stop_condition).
